# `kll_sketch_get_n_float`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the number of items collected in the sketch.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
kll_sketch_get_n_float(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- kll_sketch_get_n_float, example 1
> SELECT kll_sketch_get_n_float(kll_sketch_agg_float(col)) FROM VALUES (CAST(1.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(2.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(3.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(4.0 AS FLOAT)), (CAST(5.0 AS FLOAT)) tab(col);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.1.0.
